title: With turn-gated control OFF, source-root naming and host check credit stop for new roots (naming requires turn_gated_control)
outcome: Turning a project's turn-gated control off (to stop turn-begin admission) no longer takes away source-root naming and host verification credit for new work, so agents can keep earning recorded checks while admission is disabled.
acceptance: An agreed design (Architect concurrence recorded on this item) states which host behaviours depend on turn-begin admission (turn_gated_control) and which only on Engram being enabled for the project (is_base_enabled); source-root naming and check recording are classified explicitly.

With enabled=true and turn_gated_control=false, termal_name_source_root for a root session holding the work's claim succeeds or is refused only for a reason other than 'Engram control is not enabled', per the agreed design; a regression test covers it and fails on the current code.
With enabled=false the refusal is unchanged; focused tests for source roots and turn checks pass on the exact input.
